posts.topic: Meta relaunches stablecoin creator payments via USDC/Stripe
posts.source_headline: Meta (META) starts stablecoin payout to creators in Circle's USDC on Polygon, Solana via Stripe
posts.content: Meta killed its own stablecoin project, Diem, in January 2022 rather than fight regulators for the right to issue currency. Four years later, the replacement uses USDC not Diem, Stripe not Novi, Polygon and Solana not a proprietary chain, and launches in Colombia and Philippines, two of the world's largest remittance corridors. My read: the $293 billion stablecoin market built itself in Meta's absence, and Meta just quietly re-entered as a distribution layer.
